description: This header defines the GatekeeperStorage abstract class responsible for secure data storage operations tailored for Android's Gatekeeper, including methods for allocation, key existence checking, reading, and writing binary data buffers. It includes licensing information and necessary includes.

classes.name: GatekeeperStorage
classes.description: Abstract class providing an interface for secure storage of binary blobs, with methods for allocating storage, checking key existence, reading, and writing data.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates storage for a given key and size.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key, returning a unique pointer to a TPM2B_MAX_NV_BUFFER.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to storage associated with a key.
